Glossary
Aging A progressive sequence of detrimental age-related changes that occur in every individual of a given species, at varying
rates. These changes lead to a breakdown in normal homeostatic mechanisms so that the functional capacity of the body and
its ability to respond to a wide variety of extrinsic and intrinsic agents is often reduced. This causes degradation of structural
